messages.subject: For Luis Gallego | Global aviation, government relations and infrastructure stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear IAG Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Luis Gallego, Chief Executive Officer.

IAG's portfolio of leading airlines operates at the intersection of governments, aviation regulation, airport infrastructure, sustainability and international connectivity. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and strategic stakeholder execution might support IAG's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to International Airlines Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
